title: Positional Rolling
shortDefinition: Positional rolling starts in a specific situation with clear win and reset conditions.
whyItMatters: It turns knowledge into timing through repetitions that open rolling rarely gives enough of.
deepExplanation: You can spar side-control escape, back retention, bodylock pass, or front-headlock defense. The key is limiting goals so feedback is clear: pass or recover, finish or escape.
beginnerView: Start in the position you need to fix instead of waiting for it in live rolling.
advancedView: Use small constraints to test one technical cue instead of winning the whole round.
